summary: Gildan Activewear filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 shareholder report, comprising Management's Discussion and Analysis, unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the three and nine months ended September 27, 2026, and CEO/CFO certifications. No transactional event is disclosed: no acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private, activist, or capital-return action. The MD&A was approved by the Board on November 4, 2026, and prepared under IFRS/IAS 34. This is an ordinary periodic reporting filing; no deal terms, advisor, or premium apply. Watch only for operational and guidance updates within the MD&A rather than any arbitrage angle.
